text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): it adds the repo root to sys.path, loads active households via registry.load_households(active_only=True), checks eligibility for cash via 'cash' in eligibility.rules.programs(household), and calls payments.vouchers.disburse(household.id, 60, payment_key(household.id, 2)) for each eligible household, catching DuplicatePayment to skip already-paid households.
